TB.week4_result: Lost 17-14 to Green Bay at Raymond James Stadium (Oct 4). First NFL start for undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels (19/27, 148 yds, 1 TD, 2 INT, 55 rush yds); late comeback stalled on protection issues. Bucs still winless (0-4). S Antoine Winfield Jr. suffered a rib fracture in the game.

qb.notes: Baker Mayfield dislocated his right thumb late in Week 3 vs MIN; MRI showed no ligament/tendon damage but Todd Bowles says he misses a minimum of three weeks. Mayfield was DNP on the Monday (Oct 5) estimated report. Daniels (undrafted rookie, Kansas) was confirmed by Bowles as the Week 5 starter. Easton Stick was elevated from the practice squad as the Week 4 backup; Brett Rypien was added to the practice squad. Kyle Trask was released in August.
